#!/usr/bin/env python3
import re
import collections

def main():
    with open('/home/ctfplayer/ctf_files/banana.script', 'r') as f:
        content = f.read()
    
    # Find all banana patterns (case-insensitive)
    banana_patterns = re.findall(r'[bB][aA][nN][aA][nN][aA][sS]?', content)
    
    # Count occurrences of each pattern

    # Print results
    print(f"Total number of banana patterns: {len(banana_patterns)}")
